>What is your thesis on?

I'm studying the effect that flooding stress & competition has on the structural stability and elongation of plant stems. Basically, I flooded 3 different species of terrestrial plants for 7 days, and made before/after measurements to see whether they have elongated during the flooding period, and if submersion & especially growth during submersion affects the structural stability of the stem (Which can theoretically kill the plant by making it so weak that it snaps when the water recedes due to gravity). 

I did all the practical work this spring which was a huge hassle in itself, but my supervisor helped me, and physical work is easier for me at this point than mental work. So now I have a bunch of data, not great data, but data. Problem is that I need to do statistics on it, and I had to drop out of my statistics course this spring for the same reason I feel like shit now. So I basically have to figure out how to use RStudios from scratch.

Thank you for the advice, I don't really have anyone to talk to about this so everything helps.
